# 春秋傳說例

**ID:** KR1e0024
**Custom ID:** ZB1e0017
**Source:** 四庫全書 文淵閣版, V147.7, p541
**Extent:** 1 卷

## Authors / Editors
- 劉敞 (宋朝) 撰 1019 - 1068

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Chūnqiū chuán shuō lì* 春秋傳說例 in one juan is a Qīng-period reconstruction (from *Yǒnglè dàdiǎn* 永樂大典 fragments) of Liú Chǎng's [劉敞](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%8A%89%E6%95%9E) regulatory-item handbook, originally a partner volume to his commentary trilogy. The Sòng catalogues differ on the original size (Liú's *xíng zhuàng* and tomb-inscription, plus the *Sòng shǐ yìwén zhì*, give 2 juan; Chén Zhènsūn's *Shū lù jiětí*, 1 juan; the *Sòng zhì* in another listing, "11 juan" — an obvious copyist's error). The Sìkù editors recovered roughly half of the original 49 entries from the *Yǒnglè dàdiǎn*. Different from [KR1e0021](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0021) (*Quán héng*, the critical adjudication) and [KR1e0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0022) (the *zhuàn*, the running commentary), the *Shuō lì* lays out Liú's own theoretical regulations in the manner of Dù Yù's *Shì lì* ([KR1e0012](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0012)).

**Abstract**

The *Sìkù tíyào* makes the principal points: that this is the regulatory-item handbook completing Liú's *Chūnqiū* programme, on the model of Dù Yù's *Shì lì* but built on Liú's own eclectic regulations rather than Dù's; that the work was nearly lost between the Sòng and the Qīng — Sòng-Yuán commentators did not cite it after the early Southern Sòng; that the Qīng *Yǒnglè dàdiǎn* recovery preserves only about half of the 49 original items; that there is one self-contradiction with the *zhuàn* (on Guī Fù's Shēng / Chēng) and one over-reaching position (on the *Zhōulǐ* and three armies of Lǔ).
